project_name.justification: The primary project of interest is the Baptiste Nickel Project, located within the Decar Nickel District, as stated: '...the Baptiste Nickel Project ("Baptiste" or the "Project"), located within the Company's wholly-owned Decar Nickel District ("Decar").'

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as 'FPX Nickel Corp. (TSXV: FPX) (OTCQB: FPOCF) ("FPX Nickel" or the "Company")'.

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer, FPX Nickel Corp., is identified at the end of the release: 'Martin Turenne, President, CEO and Director'.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The company acquired a full interest in the claims related to the transaction: 'the Company has acquired from a previous operator a 100% interest in 18 km2 of claims adjacent to the southern boundary of Decar'.

primary_commodity.justification: The project is explicitly referred to as a nickel project throughout the document, for example in the title: 'FPX Nickel Expands Land Packages at the Decar Nickel District'.

verified_article_link.justification: No direct, specific article link was provided in the source text, only a general link to the company's main website.

currency.justification: The transaction value is given as '$185,000'. The currency is inferred to be Canadian Dollars (CAD) as the acquiring company, FPX Nickel Corp., is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange ('Exchange: TSXV').

cash_payments_raw.justification: The cash payment for the Decar claims is explicitly stated: 'the Company has acquired from a previous operator a 100% interest in 18 km2 of claims adjacent to the southern boundary of Decar, for cash consideration of $185,000'. The separate $50,000 payment for the Klow project was ignored as it is not the project of interest.

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction was for cash consideration only.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The transaction was for cash consideration only, not a combined payment.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: No shares were issued as part of the transaction consideration.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants were mentioned as part of the transaction.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options were mentioned as part of the transaction.

issued_share_price.justification: No shares were issued as part of the transaction consideration.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: No exploration commitment in meters was mentioned for the Decar project.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The text mentions a '$1,000,000 in exploration expenditures' commitment, but this is explicitly for the Klow Project, not the Baptiste/Decar project of interest.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The text mentions a '1.5% NSR royalty', but this is related to a potential dilution scenario on the Klow Project, not the Baptiste/Decar project.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The area acquired in the M&A transaction for the Decar project is specified as 18 km2: 'the Company has acquired from a previous operator a 100% interest in 18 km2 of claims adjacent to the southern boundary of Decar'.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the acquired area is specified in the text: '...acquired from a previous operator a 100% interest in 18 km2 of claims...'

resource_size.justification: The text describes the project as a 'large-scale greenfield discovery' but does not provide a quantified mineral resource estimate with mass or volume units (e.g., tonnes, ounces).

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's ticker and exchange are explicitly stated in the first paragraph: 'FPX Nickel Corp. (TSXV: FPX)'.
